[[Urgoz's Longbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] obtained from [[Urgoz's Chest]], which appears after killing [[Urgoz]], the final [[boss]] of [[Urgoz's Warren]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:Health +30
